subject.title: fix(media): support configurable containerWorkdir in sandbox media path normalization (#98446)

question: Must the selected fix PR demonstrate a real OpenShell container-backed attachment transfer before merge, or is direct production-helper output plus committed regression tests sufficient?
rationale: The provided terminal transcript exercises the exact changed mapper on real filesystem paths, but it does not verify the full external backend and outbound-delivery integration required by the stricter interpretation of repository proof policy.

options.title: Require live OpenShell transfer
options.body: Capture redacted output, logs, or a recording of a `/sandbox` attachment sent through reply or message action, including an off-root rejection control.

options.title: Accept helper-level proof
options.body: Treat the production-helper transcript and complete committed regression tests as sufficient for this in-process mapping change.

recommendation.title: Require live OpenShell transfer
recommendation.body: Capture redacted output, logs, or a recording of a `/sandbox` attachment sent through reply or message action, including an off-root rejection control.

likelyOwner.reason: Merged history connects this person to the original media mapper, outbound media policy, sandbox tool plumbing, and OpenShell backend contract.
